scope: Public literature and regulatory records only. No patient measurements or gated data.
archival_status: Sources opened through web tools and the publisher supplement retrieved and text-extracted in memory. Supplement response bytes were hashed but not archived. Curated inputs are hashed by the arithmetic script.
decision: Systemic peak exposure is feasible; retain only as a preclinical hypothesis. Uridine-alone exact-genotype efficacy and a chronic oncology-safe therapeutic window are unknown.

sources.opened_scope: Primary full main text, Figure 4 legend and methods; actual 42-page publisher supplement retrieved and extracted in memory. Supplementary Figures 13-14 (PDF pages 13-14) examined; full-file text search performed. No component-specific arm found. Reviewer recheck: main-text checkpoint comparison and NCIH508 nonresponse, with Supplementary Figures 2d-i and 13b,c cited there.
sources.supports: Four-ribonucleoside supplementation; 48-hour segregation-error reductions of 45-55% in four CIN-positive colorectal lines; methods list 0.3 or 30 micromolar.
sources.does_not_establish: Uridine-alone rescue or sufficiency, necessity of all four components, minimum effective concentration, exact Figure 4 dose assignment, explicit per-component interpretation, BUB1B-MVA rescue or clinical benefit.
sources.transfer_limits: No observed checkpoint-function difference between CIN groups; 18q-normal CIN-positive NCIH508 did not respond. These context limits do not prove BUB1B nonresponse.

sources.identifier_note: Official regulatory labeling; no article PMID or DOI assigned.
sources.opened_scope: Full label; sections 1-2, 6.1, 12.3 Table 3 and 13.1. Root and pharmacology agent verified.
sources.supports: FDA-approved hereditary orotic aciduria indication, oral formulation, published regimen, plasma uridine PK, small chronic safety cohort and standard genotoxicity results.
sources.does_not_establish: Patient-specific exposure, 24-hour trough/AUC, unbound or intracellular exposure, MVA efficacy, or cancer-predisposition safety.

sources.opened_scope: PDF printed pages 51-54 and 66 (zero-based PDF indices 53-56 and 68), including carcinogenicity review and waiver recommendation; root and pharmacology agent reviewed.
sources.supports: Reported experience up to 19 years without reported neoplasia; negative standard genotoxicity studies; no identified treatment-related immunosuppression/neoplastic pattern in reviewed studies; carcinogenicity-study waiver rationale.
sources.does_not_establish: A quantified long-term cancer denominator or surveillance design, zero tumors in all animals, a formal negative two-year rodent carcinogenicity study, or safety in BUB1B-MVA. One rat mammary adenocarcinoma was judged incidental.

sources.opened_scope: Primary main text and replication-stress results, root and mechanism agent.
sources.supports: BubR1 acetylation-defective mouse K243R model replication stress and chromosome rearrangements.
sources.does_not_establish: The behavior of human N1002K, nucleotide shortage, or rescue by uridine/nucleoside supplementation.

sources.opened_scope: Primary PubMed abstract accessed through indexed search; primary publisher abstract/snippets also inspected. Full figures and exposure durations not verified. Root independently checked the 10/30 micromolar units.
sources.supports: Uridine at 10 or 30 micromolar caused uracil-DNA damage/damage signaling in four cancer cell lines; UPase-knockout mice had greater than threefold spontaneous tumorigenesis.
sources.does_not_establish: A human toxicity threshold, oral Xuriden cancer risk, rhabdomyosarcoma recurrence risk, or a clinical therapeutic index. Knockout is not a drug-treatment experiment.

sources.opened_scope: Primary full text, root and oncology agent.
sources.supports: UPP1-dependent use of uridine-derived ribose by glucose-restricted pancreatic cancer and growth consequences in experimental models.
sources.does_not_establish: RMS growth promotion or recurrence in children receiving approved Xuriden.

sources.opened_scope: PubMed primary abstract and accessible figure legends; root independently opened abstract. PMC full-text access was blocked.
sources.supports: PAX3-FOXO1-positive RMS pyrimidine dependence and rescue of methotrexate sensitivity by provision of pyrimidines.
sources.does_not_establish: Uridine-alone rescue, clinical Xuriden interactions with the child's unknown treatment, or the child's fusion status.

sources.opened_scope: Primary PubMed abstract, root and oncology agent; full exposure-response figures not verified.
sources.supports: Uridine supplementation supported CD8 T-cell antitumor function in experimental mouse models.
sources.does_not_establish: A clinical anticancer dose, chronic Xuriden cancer prevention, or net safety in BUB1B-MVA.
